items.briefing:
Quest Apartment Hotels has confirmed a customer data breach caused by a vulnerability in a third-party system, so if you've stayed with Quest recently, monitor your accounts for suspicious activity. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) is warning that attackers are actively exploiting a vulnerability in N-able N-central software used by many IT managed service providers in Australia — if your organisation uses this tool, ensure it is patched immediately.

ASIC is also alerting Australians about scammers using AI-generated deepfakes to create convincing fake investment networks. These scams can look extremely legitimate, so be sceptical of any unsolicited investment opportunities online.

**Tip:** If you receive an unexpected investment offer via social media or email, verify it independently through ASIC's website before engaging.

featured.title: Semperis launches global tour for cyber war documentary
featured.summary: The documentary's global rollout will take its account of cyber attacks on vital services to more than 30 cities, including Sydney.
